Easy Home WAF

Sign in

Use http://this-host:8000 or https://this-host:8443 (browser warns until you install a trusted cert in the panel). Default admin / admin — change password after first login.

Change password

You must set a new password (min 8 characters) before using the control plane.

Until this step is done, the Applications / Apply buttons stay hidden — not disabled.

Signed in. Optional: legacy automation EASY_WAF_ADMIN_TOKEN still works as Bearer.

Dark gray buttons (Sign out, Load certificates, …) are still clickable — that is the secondary style, not disabled.

Applications

Add / update

Each Save app adds a new published host → backend mapping (new row). Pick a profile preset below; then Apply HAProxy.

Restricted paths

Limit a URL prefix to LAN CIDRs only (e.g. Home Assistant /api). One CIDR per line.

After saving, click Apply HAProxy. Requires haproxy for validation unless EASY_WAF_SKIP_RELOAD is set.

Certificates

Status / dates from database; issue flows via API or ACME worker.

IP Blacklist

Local CIDRs and optional external lists → ip_blacklist.map. Sync refreshes the map file; Apply HAProxy still needed for a new config.

IP Allowlist

Trusted CIDRs bypass IP blacklist and per-app HTTP rate limits when enabled. Map: ip_allowlist.map. Toggle + Apply HAProxy to activate.

Bot Protection

Block empty User-Agent and optional substring list (written to blocked_ua.map on Apply HAProxy). Substring ACL runs after IP allowlist.

CrowdSec (LAPI)

Requires crowdsec_lapi_url and machine bouncer key in settings (see install-interactive.sh / docs).



    
Global settings (ACME)

    
acmed stays idle until ACME email is set. Save uses PATCH /api/v1/settings (only changed fields; other settings are left intact).

    

      
      
      
      
      
    

    


    
GeoIP

    
When enabled, Sync lists / Apply HAProxy resolve blacklist CIDRs to countries and refresh geoip_enforce.map. Optional API token: env GEOIP_IPINFO_TOKEN on the API host.
